newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pakistan passes on palm oil tender - traders.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan passes on palm oil tender - traders.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) has passed on its tender for 6,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil and 3,000 tonnes of RBD palm olein on Tuesday, traders said.
The lowest bidder for the palm oil was Pan Century which offered $559.40 per tonne, while Felda put in the lowest bid of $595 a tonne for the palm olein.
TCP wanted the consignments delivered by October 10.
India's State Trading Corporation is also in the market for 6,000 tonnes of RBD palm olein for first half October shipment. Results of the tender will be known later today.
